title: Escarpment and Trail
author: Yara Ishikawa
blurb: Astrid Vane, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
